name: ipaddr2-windows
shortdesc: Resource agent for controlling an IPv4 cluster IP address
longdesc:
Resource agent for controlling an IPv4 cluster IP address.
It uses the netsh utility to add and remove the IP
address. It uses the ipconfig tool to check if the
IP address is configured and up and running.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.longdesc: The IPv4 cluster IP address. Example: 10.43.224.99.

parameters.name: nic
parameters.shortdesc: The network interface for the IP address
parameters.longdesc:
The network interface where this cluster IP should be bound
to. Example: "Ethernet Instance 0". This must match exactly
the Name of the network interface (which might be longer).

parameters.name: cidr_netmask
parameters.shortdesc: Network prefix length in CIDR notation (e.g. 24)
parameters.longdesc:
The network prefix length in CIDR notation, e.g. 24 for a /24
(255.255.255.0) network. If not specified, the netsh command will
use the interface's existing subnet mask.
